body:
Founder real-time: 'do fog of war as an ability' -> 'add to the duck' -> 'there is no natural fog of war just duck smoke bomb' -> 'server authorittive' -> 'as a parena mod' -> 'mod first dev.' This engine has no vision/LOS system anywhere -- Smoke Bomb implements the one honest, buildable analog: hero_obscured_from blocks arena_nearest_enemy from selecting a hero standing inside an active smoke cloud when the caster is outside it (symmetric per-cloud). New duck_smoke_ms/x/z fields on ArenaHero (new W-slot zone, Duck's R has none of its own). Cast via arena_toggle_w's new DUCK case, routed through the PARENA-compiled on_duck_smoke_bomb_cast (PARENA commit 191c342) -- mod is the trigger. Decremented inside the shared tick_hero_kit (not duplicated per top-level tick function) -- deliberately avoiding the exact S202-23 Tree-passive bug class, verified through both arena_update and arena_update_teams. Wire-synced + client-rendered (real cloud footprint + cast-radius preview). 13 new tests, all passing. All 4 build paths wired up front. Found (not fixed, out of scope, flagged) a pre-existing test_arena_replay segfault, confirmed via git-stash bisect to predate this change. REDGARDEN commit 18ef461.

⚓ ☃
title: Duck W -- Smoke Bomb shipped, real target-denial AoE (S202-10)
